main.description: A voice call in a room — one record per call, written to the space's repo and keyed by the call's id. The call ending deletes it.

room.description: The room the call is in: the record key of a `space.roomy.space.room` record.

source.description: Which path produced this call fact.

startedAt.description: When the call started, in epoch milliseconds.

joined.description: The participant the last join fact named.

left.description: The participant the last leave fact named.
